charts.title: HIP 41378 b: orbits around HIP 41378
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 41378's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 41378 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Berardo et al. 2019 (2019AJ....157..185B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BERARDO_ET_AL__2019): P 15.572098 d

charts.title: HIP 41378 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 41378 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (61, 72, 88) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 366443426, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 17 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 21-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min early; 21-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
